body:
## Problem
In `packages/gate-manifest/bin/gate-manifest.mjs`, the fall-through unknown-verb error message (`unknown verb: ${verb}. Expected: record | verify | show | attest | repair-chain | generate-key | enable | adopt`) omits the implemented `migrate` and `migrate-branch` verbs that are listed in `USAGE`.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `packages/gate-manifest/bin/gate-manifest.mjs` includes `migrate` and `migrate-branch` in the `Expected:` list on unknown-verb errors (`record | verify | show | attest | repair-chain | generate-key | enable | migrate | migrate-branch | adopt`). Verify: `node --test packages/gate-manifest/test/gate-manifest.test.mjs`.
2. Existing `migrate` and `migrate-branch` behavior is unchanged. Verify: `node --test packages/gate-manifest/test/migrate.test.mjs packages/gate-manifest/test/migrate-branch.test.mjs`.
title: fix(gate-manifest): include migrate and migrate-branch in unknown-verb error message (#655)
